critique.evidence: Measured across desktop, tablet, and mobile: LCP is 704/632/548 ms, FCP 60/52/76 ms, load 144/141/237 ms, and TTFB 5.8/1.3/2.2 ms. CLS is excellent on desktop/mobile (0.0011/0) but higher on tablet (0.0478). No console, page, or request failures occurred; all tested API responses returned 200. Frame tests recorded no long frames, though desktop averaged 20.73 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame versus ~16.67 ms on tablet/mobile. Transfer cost is relatively heavy: 1.31 MB total, including 1.15 MB JavaScript, across 17 requests. Document width matched viewport at all sizes.
critique.fix: Reduce the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting and dependency trimming; profile desktop rendering to bring average frames below 16.7 ms, and reserve tablet layout dimensions to reduce its 0.0478 CLS.
